workarounds.note: debug.looseLineHighlight is painted only by the Sandbox: marks() reads line.justifiedSpaceRatio, line.ragged and the split fragments from the VDT, and paintMarks() draws the highlighter on the comparison canvases (gotcha sandbox-only-warnings)
the ragged slip neither sets nor names hyphenation: false, since ragged text is never hyphenated (gotcha ragged-no-hyphenation)
the opener title's lineHeight is a multiple (1.02), never a dimension (gotcha design-lineheight-multiple)
col() writes the hex beside every paletteId and bodyText.referenceColor is restated in ink: 1.4.1 skips the palette in design slots and in the reference colour (gotcha palette-skips-designs)
the H1 breakBefore is restated because a headings object drops it (gotcha headings-drop-h1-break)
the band box, not the diagram image, reserves the opener's height: 1.4.1 ignores image elements when it measures an advancedDesign (gotcha opener-image-no-reserve)

column balancing pushes a box that ends a column down to the column's foot, away from its paragraph (drop the sentence 'Much tighter… sees the gaps.' and the minWordSpacing box on p. 2 sits two lines under its paragraph): the essay is copy-fitted so every non-final column is full

what.en: The essay “The river problem” and its Spanish version “El problema de los ríos”, the bench test and the diagram, written and drawn for this recipe
what.es: El ensayo «El problema de los ríos» y su versión inglesa, «The river problem», el banco de pruebas y el diagrama, escritos y dibujados para esta receta
